adlc-engineering-datapack.title: ADR-002: Unit-of-Work & Repository Pattern
adlc-engineering-datapack.problemSignature: Team architectural constraint: Direct SQL or raw ORM calls in HTTP route controllers are strictly forbidden. All data access must pass through Repository interfaces governed by Unit-of-Work.
adlc-engineering-datapack.rootCause: Prevent architectural drift and inconsistent patterns across developer tools
adlc-engineering-datapack.verifiedFix: Direct SQL or raw ORM calls in HTTP route controllers are strictly forbidden. All data access must pass through Repository interfaces governed by Unit-of-Work.

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: AUTHENTICATION: Intermittent 401 Unauthorized during concurrent dashboa
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: Intermittent 401 Unauthorized during concurrent dashboard load | When users refresh our dashboard containing 6 parallel widgets, all 6 widgets fire simultaneous requ | HTTP 401 Unauthorized - {"error": "token_revoked", "error_description": "Token reuse detected on refresh token rotation"}
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Race condition on concurrent API requests using Refresh Token Rotation (RTR). First request consumes refresh token; subsequent parallel requests trigger replay-attack invalidation of entire token family.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Implement single-flight promise locking for in-flight /oauth/token refresh requests.; Queue secondary concurrent requests behind the active refresh promise.; Configure 30-second server grace period for in-transit token leeway window.; Update client HTTP interceptor to deduplicate 401 events.

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: WEBHOOKS: Webhook signature verification fails on all POST reques
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: Webhook signature verification fails on all POST requests | We are receiving webhooks for order.created, but our receiver keeps failing HMAC validation. We chec | WebhookSignatureVerificationError: Signatures do not match. Expected e3b0c44298fc1c14... received 7a3b8901...
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: HMAC-SHA256 signature mismatch caused by standard JSON body-parser re-encoding payload before digest verification, altering byte order or stripping whitespace.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Preserve unparsed raw Buffer stream from incoming HTTP request before JSON parsing.; Compute HMAC digest directly on rawBuffer using crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).; Compare digests using crypto.timingSafeEqual() to prevent timing side-channel leaks.

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: RATE-LIMITING: Bulk data export job crashing with 429 Too Many Request
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: Bulk data export job crashing with 429 Too Many Requests | We kick off an hourly bulk sync job that fetches records in 50 concurrent threads. Within 4 seconds, | HTTP 429 Too Many Requests - {"error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "limit": 5000, "retry_after": 12}
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Burst batch workers exceeding Token Bucket limit and retrying without inspecting Retry-After header or adding jitter, triggering secondary blocking penalties.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Inspect Retry-After HTTP response header on 429 status.; Implement Full-Jitter Exponential Backoff algorithm: sleep = random_uniform(0, min(max_backoff, base * 2^attempt)).; Clamp batch concurrency worker pool to stay below 80% of sustained rate limit.

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: BILLING: Customer confused by unexpected negative charge on seat
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: Customer confused by unexpected negative charge on seat downgrade | A customer downgraded from 50 seats to 20 seats on day 15 of their 30-day billing cycle. They expect | Billing Notice: Proration item -$450.00 applied to customer balance, invoice total $0.00
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Mid-cycle subscription downgrade creates an unapplied credit balance item on the customer account rather than an automatic cash refund to credit card.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Clarify to customer that seat removal generates a positive credit memo towards next month's invoice.; Use stripe.invoices.retrieveUpcoming({ proration_date: timestamp }) to show real-time invoice adjustment prior to confirmation.; If customer demands cash return, issue an explicit refund against the original charge ID via Stripe dashboard/API.

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: CORS: Browser blocking POST requests with CORS preflight 403
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: Browser blocking POST requests with CORS preflight 403 Forbidden | Our single page application at app.frontend.com cannot call api.frontend.com/v1/auth. Chrome DevTool | Access to fetch at 'https://api.frontend.com/v1/auth' from origin 'https://app.frontend.com' has been blocked by CORS policy: Response to preflight request doesn't have HTTP ok status.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Edge reverse proxy / API gateway intercepting CORS preflight OPTIONS requests and returning 401/403 because authentication tokens are omitted by browsers during preflight.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Configure edge proxy (NGINX/Cloudflare/ALB) to bypass auth middlewares on OPTIONS requests.; Return HTTP 204 No Content directly from edge proxy for valid origins.; Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin to specific requesting Origin (never wildcard '*' when credentials=include).

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: CORS: CORS error: The value of Access-Control-Allow-Origin ca
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: CORS error: The value of Access-Control-Allow-Origin cannot be wildcard when credentials used | Frontend uses credentials: include for session cookies. Server responds with Access-Control-Allow-Or | The value of the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header in the response must not be the wildcard '*' when the request's credentials mode is 'include'.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Edge reverse proxy / API gateway intercepting CORS preflight OPTIONS requests and returning 401/403 because authentication tokens are omitted by browsers during preflight.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Configure edge proxy (NGINX/Cloudflare/ALB) to bypass auth middlewares on OPTIONS requests.; Return HTTP 204 No Content directly from edge proxy for valid origins.; Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin to specific requesting Origin (never wildcard '*' when credentials=include).

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: DATABASE: API servers hanging with Connection pool timeout after
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: API servers hanging with Connection pool timeout after high load | After running a heavy batch of payment reconciliation webhooks, all backend API servers stop accepti | TimeoutError: ResourceRequest timed out after 30000ms. Active: 50, Idle: 0, Pending: 87
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Database connection leak caused by missing finally release block in error handlers, steadily exhausting pool until server max_connections is saturated.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Ensure pool.connect() client is wrapped in try...finally with client.release() in finally.; Set statement_timeout = 15000 and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 30000 on DB server.; Deploy PgBouncer / Yugabyte smart client connection pooling for serverless and batch workers.

omni-resolve-shared-datapack.title: STORAGE: Large 500MB video uploads failing at 95% with 403 Reque
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.problemSignature: Large 500MB video uploads failing at 95% with 403 Request has expired | Users uploading 4K video files over residential broadband fail after ~15 minutes. The presigned PUT | RequestTimeTooSkewedThe difference between the request time and the current time is too large.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.rootCause: Presigned upload URL expired prior to completion of slow network transfer; client aborted entire file instead of chunk-level resumption.
omni-resolve-shared-datapack.verifiedFix: Mandate S3 Multipart Upload API for files exceeding 50MB.; Generate short-lived (10 min) presigned URLs per individual chunk just-in-time.; Allow client to retry only failed/expired chunks with a fresh presigned URL without discarding previous parts.

marketing-campaign-learnings.verifiedFix: Mandate specific engineering metrics (-80% tokens), named IDE integrations (Cursor/Claude Code), and compliance guarantees (RBAC/YugabyteDB)
